name: Museum of the War of Chinese People's Resistance Against Japanese Aggression
scope: Standing main museum and the two stepped southern terraces, after the 2025 reopening at Wanping, Beijing.
era: Current exterior after the July 2025 reopening.

stories.title: Museum of the War of Chinese People's Resistance Against Japanese Aggression

originalReview.notes: The front view after reopening establishes the tiled eaves, two masonry pylons framing the raised central block, dark ribbon glazing, recessed red timber bays, and entrance terraces. Temporary people, signage, flags and sculptural plaques were excluded.

review.method: Exact published Qualla CC0 exterior photograph and native map.
review.notes: The exact 2025 exterior reference was already published on Qualla and its creator’s CC0 dedication was verified. Municipal heritage facts and the 2025 contractor’s account govern the approach and overall design.
